name: A Lithic Lance button is saved as Geode Barrage (#5469)
contract: With the Lithic Lance specialization passive 706159, Lithic Lance Ready 807048 runs aura_ascension_lithic_lance_ready::Apply (AscensionPrimalistLithicLance.cpp:38), which learns Lithic Lance 681251 as a temporary spell (learnSpell(LithicLance, true), line 44) and replaces the highest known Geode Barrage rank (chain 500402) with it through SetTemporarySpellReplacement (line 50). A temporary spell is never written to character_spell, and Player::_LoadActions runs before the buff is gained again, so a saved Lithic Lance button would be refused and deleted at login. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the spell id _SaveActions writes: a button holding Lithic Lance must be saved as the replaced Geode Barrage rank 502770, and a button holding that rank itself is saved unchanged.

steps.label: Lithic Lance replaces the highest Geode Barrage rank
The Lithic Lance button is saved as Geode Barrage
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
